summary: Completed end-to-end testing for Epsilon Executive Education landing page (Cohort 01). Backend pytest suite (9 tests) and Playwright UI flows all pass against the public preview URL. Apply and Schedule-a-call dialogs open from every entry point (Nav, Hero, FinalCTA, FAQ). Form submissions persist data via /api/applications and /api/contacts and surface success toasts. Empty-form validation, email format validation (422), and sorted listing all behave correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: All endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projection ({_id: 0}) and Pydantic ConfigDict extra='ignore'.
EmailStr validation correctly returns 422 on invalid email format.
created_at is stored as ISO string in Mongo and re-parsed on read; sort by created_at desc works because ISO 8601 sorts lexicographically.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes; Apply/Schedule dialogs use shadcn Select that requires role='option' selectors (not visible-text) because radix renders a hidden native option.
Suggestion (non-blocking): Consider adding rate limiting / captcha on POST /api/applications and /api/contacts to prevent abuse of public submission endpoints.
Suggestion (non-blocking): server.py is small and clean (<130 lines); fine to stay single-file.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (dialog open from Nav/Hero/FinalCTA/FAQ, FAQ accordion, smooth scroll, empty-form toast, valid apply submission, valid schedule submission)

seed_data_creation: Created test applications and contacts prefixed 'TEST_' via API and UI submissions (left in DB as records).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. For UI form tests on Apply/Schedule dialogs, the Years and Preferred-time fields use shadcn (Radix) Select - select options via page.get_by_role('option', name='...') not text= selectors because Radix renders a duplicate hidden native <option> that intercepts the locator. Dialogs close via Escape; wait for state='detached' before next interaction. No mocked APIs.
